episodes.title: The Kirtland Cult Murders: The Dark Story Hidden in Ohio History
episodes.description:
Last time we explored how Kirtland become one of the most important places in early Mormon history. But nearly 150 years later, another religious group would gather in the same town - and this story would end vary differently.

In this episode of Series by Derek, we examine the Jeffrey Lungren cult murders, one of Ohio's most disturbing true crime cases. What Began as a  small religious group eventually led to the murder of the Avery family and shocked the entire state.

This video combines on-location footage from Kirtland with historical photographs and court records to tell the story behind one of Ohio's most Infamous crimes.

episodes.title: Why the Mormons Were Driven Out of Ohio | The Kirtland Story
episodes.description:
In the early 1800's, a new religious movement began with a vision in the woods of New York,

With just a few years, that movement would grow rapidly, face intense opposition, build a temple in Ohio, collapse under scandal, and eventually split into multiple factions after the death of its founder, Joseph Smith.

In this episode of Stories by Derek, we explore the rise and fall of the Mormon settlement in Kirland, Ohio - including the construction of the Kirtland Temple, the financial collapse that shook the movement, and the events that eventually led west toward Utah.

Nearly 200 years later, the story came full circle when ownership of the Kirtland Temple changed hands once again.

Filmed on location in Kirtland and Fairport Harbor, Ohio.
